def _has_num(t, target, tol):
    for x in re.findall(r"-?\d[\d,]*\.?\d*", t.replace("$", "")):
        try:
            if abs(float(x.replace(",", "")) - target) <= tol:
                return True
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return False


def _body_paras(t):
    ls = nonempty_lines(t)
    if len(ls) < 4:
        return None
    body = "\n\n".join(p.strip() for p in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", t.strip())[1:] if p.strip())
    paras = [p.strip() for p in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", body) if p.strip()]
    paras = [p for p in paras if not p.startswith("Subject:") and not p.startswith("Dear ")
             and not p.startswith("Sincerely")]
    if paras and paras[0].startswith("Dear"):
        paras = paras[1:]
    return paras[:4] if len(paras) >= 4 else paras


def _code_counts(t):
    seg = _section(t, "ROUTE CASE", "DEMAND EVIDENCE")
    codes = re.findall(r"\b([A-Z]{3})-([A-Z]{3}):", seg)
    flat = [c for pair in codes for c in pair]
    return len(codes) == 5 and flat and max(flat.count(c) for c in set(flat)) <= 2


def _asc_by_cpp(t):
    rows = md_table(t)[1:]
    vals = []
    for r in rows:
        if len(r) < 4:
            return False
        m = re.search(r"\d[\d,]*\.?\d*", r[3].replace("$", ""))
        if not m:
            return False
        vals.append(float(m.group(0).replace(",", "")))
    return len(vals) == 6 and all(vals[i] <= vals[i + 1] for i in range(5))


def _ship_status(t):
    want = {}
    for oid, _, _, _, mode, days in SHIP_ROWS:
        limit = 7 if mode == "air" else 30
        want[oid] = "ON STANDARD" if days <= limit else "EXCEPTION"
    rows = md_table(t)[1:]
    if len(rows) != 6:
        return False
    for r in rows:
        oid = r[0].strip()
        if oid not in want or want[oid] not in r[-1].upper():
            return False
    return True


def _ww_compliance(t):
    want = ["COMPLIANT", "COMPLIANT", "EXCEEDANCE", "COMPLIANT", "EXCEEDANCE",
            "COMPLIANT", "COMPLIANT"]
